game.core.rules.readable.title: Turns and Action Budgets
game.core.rules.readable.summary: An encounter turn records its active participant and the Action, Bonus Action, and Reaction budget available to that participant.

blocks.heading: Turn lifecycle
items: Start the next eligible participant's turn and initialize its recorded budget.
Spend a budget entry only when the chosen activity requires it.
End and advance the turn after resolving the participant's declared activity and state changes.

blocks.heading: Timing is recorded
blocks.body: The interface reports the current budget; encounter-turn and turn-budget mechanics own spending and advancement.

citations.locator: Playing the Game > Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, and Interacting with Objects; Combat > Your Turn, PDF pp. 9 and 25
